about: 李录是喜马拉雅资本创始人兼董事长。1997 年创立公司后，一直管理其主要基金；他在哥伦比亚大学同时取得 BA、JD 和 MBA 三个学位。
Li Lu is the founder and chairman of Himalaya Capital. He has managed its principal fund since founding the firm in 1997, after earning BA, JD and MBA degrees simultaneously at Columbia University.
他的投资脉络承接格雷厄姆、巴菲特与芒格：把股票背后的企业研究透，在自己的能力圈里等待好机会，机会真正出现时敢于集中投入。喜马拉雅主要投资亚洲和北美，关注护城河、成长空间与值得信任的管理层。

His approach follows Graham, Buffett and Munger: understand the underlying business, wait patiently within a circle of competence, and commit decisively when an exceptional opportunity appears. Himalaya focuses mainly on Asia and North America, looking for durable moats, growth and trustworthy managers.
深度研究和长期持有，是理解李录的两个关键词。喜马拉雅的一些投资已持有二十年；他也在公开演讲中反复讨论，如何在无法左右的宏观环境里，找到自己能够理解并有所作为的企业。

Deep research and long-term ownership define his approach. Some Himalaya investments have been held for twenty years. His public talks examine how an investor can understand individual businesses while accepting a macro environment beyond their control.
李录把价值投资讲成一套认识世界的方法：承认自己不知道什么，区分企业的经济价值与市场给出的价格，再通过长期研究扩展能力圈。他的公开演讲经常把商业文明、制度与资本市场放在一起讨论，最终落脚于具体企业如何为社会创造价值、为所有者积累财富。

Li Lu presents value investing as a way to understand the world: recognize the limits of knowledge, distinguish economic value from market price, and expand competence through sustained research. His talks connect commercial civilization and capital markets with the concrete question of how businesses create value for society and accumulate wealth for owners.
芒格不仅是他经常引用的思想来源，也是其长期投资实践中的重要伙伴。喜马拉雅官网以相互信任、可靠的人与长期合作来表达机构文化；这种文化与他强调的诚实、理性、深度研究相互呼应。

Munger is an important intellectual influence and a significant partner in Li Lu’s investing life. Himalaya’s website emphasizes mutual trust, reliable people and enduring cooperation, consistent with Li Lu’s focus on honesty, rationality and deep research.

about: Mohnish Pabrai 是 Pabrai Investment Funds 创始人及管理合伙人，也是 Pabrai Wagons Fund 的组合经理。首只 Pabrai 基金于 1999 年启动。
Mohnish Pabrai founded Pabrai Investment Funds and is its managing partner. He also manages the Pabrai Wagons Fund; the first Pabrai fund launched in 1999.
帕伯莱最鲜明的两张名片是 Cloning 与 Dhandho：前者是坦然学习巴菲特、芒格等人的有效方法，再做自己的研究；后者是寻找“正面我赢，反面我也输不了多少”的机会，先想清楚会损失什么，再考虑能赚多少。

Pabrai is closely associated with Cloning and Dhandho. Cloning means learning openly from effective methods, then doing independent research. Dhandho seeks asymmetric opportunities: first understand what could be lost, then assess what could be gained.
著作 The Dhandho Investor 将这套思路讲得直白而生动。他通过 Chai with Pabrai 分享访谈与投资思考，也创办 Dakshana Foundation，将教育公益作为投资之外的长期事业。

The Dhandho Investor presents this framework in direct, memorable terms. He shares interviews and investment thinking on Chai with Pabrai and founded Dakshana Foundation as a long-term commitment to educational philanthropy.
2007 年，他与盖伊·斯皮尔共同拍下巴菲特慈善午餐，实际会面在 2008 年 6 月。投资学习与公益在这次经历中相连：午餐款项支持 GLIDE，他创办的 Dakshana 则为经济困难的优秀学生提供升学辅导。

In 2007 he and Guy Spier jointly won Buffett’s charity lunch auction; the meal took place in June 2008. The proceeds supported GLIDE, while his Dakshana Foundation provides entrance-exam coaching to gifted students facing financial hardship.
他早年经营信息技术企业 TransTech，后来才转向基金管理。因此，他讲投资时常从企业主的账本出发：投入多少资本，能产生多少现金，最坏情形下还剩什么，以及有没有不必持续追加资本的好生意。企业经营经历，也让他的案例通常比抽象公式更直观。

Before managing funds he ran TransTech, an information technology business. His investing explanations often begin with an owner’s arithmetic: capital required, cash produced, what remains in adversity, and whether a business needs continual funding. His operating background helps make the cases concrete.
“克隆”在他那里包含主动寻找、深入核对和不断修正三个动作；检查清单则用来记住自己与其他投资者曾经犯过的错。公开作品中，旅馆、保险、汽车和资源企业各有不同的资本需求，这些具体差异正是他反复展开投资方法的地方。

For Pabrai, cloning involves looking for ideas, investigating them and revising conclusions. Checklists preserve lessons from his own and others’ mistakes. His discussions of hotels, insurance, automobiles and resources explore how different capital needs change the investment calculation.

Understand what could be lost before looking at the upside. Cloning supplies ideas; checklists and independent research decide which deserve capital.

about: 段永平是从企业经营走向投资的企业家，曾领导小霸王，后创立步步高。在雪球上，他以“大道无形我有型”分享对生意、管理和投资的理解。

Duan Yongping is an entrepreneur who moved from operating businesses into investing. He led Subor and later founded BBK, and shares his views on business, management and investing on Xueqiu as 大道无形我有型.
“买股票就是买公司”贯穿他的思路：先问生意能否持续赚钱、管理层是否可靠，再问价格是否合适。“不做空、不借钱、不懂不做”，把能力圈和不做什么放在同样重要的位置。

“Buying stocks is buying companies” defines his approach: study a business’s lasting earning power and its managers before assessing price. Avoiding shorting, borrowing and investments outside his understanding puts restraint alongside conviction.
2006 年，他以 62.01 万美元拍下巴菲特慈善午餐，2007 年实际会面。这是其学习价值投资的重要公开节点，而不是一项投资收益奖项。他也持续支持教育公益：2006 年与丁磊联合向浙江大学捐赠，2022 年再次支持母校教学设施建设。

In 2006 he won Buffett’s charity lunch auction for US$620,100, meeting him in 2007. It is a notable public milestone in his study of value investing, not an investment-performance award. His educational philanthropy includes a joint gift with Ding Lei to Zhejiang University in 2006 and further support for teaching facilities in 2022.
他的经营经验使“本分”和企业文化成为投资判断的重要组成部分：是否把消费者需要放在前面，是否坚持做对的事情，管理层是否愿意承担长期责任。产品、渠道、品牌和组织能力，在他的回答里往往比短期利润预测更重要。

His operating experience makes integrity and culture central to investment judgment: putting customers first, doing the right things and accepting long-term responsibility. Products, distribution, brands and organizational capabilities often matter more in his answers than short-term earnings forecasts.
段永平的表达通常很直接：先辨认一门生意是否真正看得懂，再决定是否值得继续研究。他也反复把投资与人生取舍联系起来，重视家庭、健康和时间的自主权。理解这种取舍，才能明白他的耐心为何同时包含长期持有与长时间不行动。

Duan’s language is direct: first decide whether a business is understandable, then whether it deserves further work. He connects investing with choices about family, health and control over time. That perspective helps explain why his patience includes both holding for years and doing nothing for long periods.

Tepper’s investment roots lie in credit analysis and distressed debt. In a sell-off, the questions are asset value, repayment capacity and survival: is risk being underestimated, or is a viable business being discarded with everything else?
他的风格也强调宏观环境与仓位调整。利率、政策和流动性变化会改变投资逻辑；有把握时集中投入，判断改变时重新评估。他同时是 Carolina Panthers 的所有者。

His approach also considers macro conditions and portfolio positioning. Rates, policy and liquidity can change an investment thesis; strong conviction warrants commitment, while changed evidence calls for reassessment. He also owns the Carolina Panthers.
泰珀在公开访谈中，经常把信用研究与市场环境一起讨论：企业能否偿债，资产能否覆盖负债，政策与资金供给会怎样改变价格。困境投资的出发点，是先弄清一家公司在压力下还能留下什么价值，再决定应当用股票还是债务参与。

In public interviews, Tepper connects credit research with the market environment: repayment ability, asset coverage, and the effects of policy and funding on prices. Distressed investing begins with what value remains under pressure before deciding whether to participate through equity or debt.
在卡内基梅隆的毕业演讲里，他讲述求学、职业挫折、家庭与回馈社会，把人生中的受助经历与后来的公益行动联系起来。这一面让他的公开形象更完整：市场上的果断，与生活中对教育、社区和机会的重视同时存在。

His Carnegie Mellon commencement address connects education, career setbacks, family and giving back. Recalling help he received and later philanthropy adds another dimension to his public life alongside decisive investment judgments.

His distinctive research tool was connecting information scattered across annual reports, announcements, directorships and ownership filings. Following a director or controlling shareholder across companies turned isolated transactions into verifiable networks of interests.
他既是实际承担投资盈亏的股东，也是持续发声的市场参与者。讨论关联交易、供股、停牌与投票安排时，他关心普通股东能否得到足够信息、受到公平对待并有效行使权利。这也解释了为何他的投资文章经常同时是一份公司治理研究。

He was both a shareholder exposed to investment outcomes and a public participant in the market. about: 沃伦·巴菲特长期领导伯克希尔·哈撒韦，被称为“奥马哈先知”。他的投资道路从格雷厄姆的低估值方法出发，在芒格的影响下，更重视优秀企业、持久竞争优势和长期复利。

Warren Buffett led Berkshire Hathaway for decades and is known as the Oracle of Omaha. Starting with Graham’s valuation discipline, he came to place greater weight on outstanding businesses, durable advantages and long-term compounding, influenced by Charlie Munger.
查理·芒格是理解这段投资生涯不可缺少的人。两人于 1959 年相识，芒格推动巴菲特从反复寻找极便宜的普通企业，转向以合适价格买入能够长期创造价值的优秀企业。巴菲特在 2023 年股东信中专门回顾了这份贡献，把芒格称为现代伯克希尔的“建筑师”。

Charlie Munger is indispensable to Buffett’s story. They met in 1959, and Munger encouraged the move from repeatedly buying very cheap ordinary businesses toward purchasing exceptional businesses at sensible prices. Buffett’s 2023 letter specifically recognized Munger as the architect of modern Berkshire.
从买入股票到收购整家企业，核心始终是生意本身：可靠的管理层、可持续的现金创造能力，以及合理的购买价格。他的年度股东信把资本配置、错误与经验讲得坦诚，是理解其思想的重要入口。

Whether buying shares or entire companies, the focus is the business: trustworthy managers, sustainable cash generation and a sensible purchase price. His shareholder letters discuss capital allocation, mistakes and experience with unusual candour.
这套方法在伯克希尔形成了具体的组织结构：保险业务提供长期资金，经营子公司持续创造现金，总部把资金投向收购、上市股票、回购或现金储备。巴菲特与芒格重视管理者的诚信与自主权，把总部的工作集中在选择人、分配资本和维护股东文化。

At Berkshire the approach took organizational form: insurance supplied long-term funding, operating subsidiaries generated cash, and headquarters allocated capital among acquisitions, public equities, repurchases and reserves. Buffett and Munger emphasized trustworthy managers and operating autonomy, concentrating headquarters on people, capital allocation and an ownership culture.
他的作品之所以值得连续阅读，在于他愿意解释判断如何形成、错误为什么发生，以及规模增长后哪些机会已经不再适用。喜诗糖果、保险业务与资本配置的讨论，共同展示了从“便宜”走向“优质且能复利”的过程；芒格的提醒贯穿其中。

The continuity of his writing reveals how judgments developed, why mistakes occurred, and which opportunities stopped working as Berkshire grew. Discussions of See’s Candies, insurance and capital allocation trace the transition from cheapness toward quality and compounding, with Munger’s influence throughout.

“复利机器”是理解阿克雷的关键词：企业能否持续赚取高资本回报，管理层能否诚实而有效地配置资金，赚到的钱又是否还有地方可以高回报地再投资。三条腿缺一条，长期复利的基础就会动摇。

“Compounding machines” captures Akre’s approach: attractive returns on capital, honest and effective capital allocation, and room to reinvest the proceeds at high returns. If one leg is missing, the foundation for long-term compounding weakens.
现任 CEO 和 CIO 是 John Neff，也是 Akre Focus ETF 的组合经理。当前机构持仓不能全部当作 Chuck Akre 本人正在管理的个人组合。
John Neff is now CEO and CIO and manages the Akre Focus ETF. Current firm holdings should not all be presented as Chuck Akre’s personal portfolio.
阿克雷早年在证券行业工作多年，之后建立自己的投资机构。他最感兴趣的问题是：为什么有些企业能长期取得显著高于普通企业的资本回报？答案既涉及定价权、客户黏性和商业模式，也涉及经营者是否能把赚到的钱继续投到好地方。

After many years in the securities industry, Akre established his own firm. His central question was why some businesses sustain unusually high returns on capital. The answer spans pricing power, customer relationships and business models, together with management’s ability to reinvest the resulting cash well.
“再投资”是这套框架里容易被忽略的一条腿。企业当前利润率再高，如果新增资本找不到良好去处，未来复利仍可能减弱。因此，他的研究把已有业务的经济性与未来扩张的空间连在一起，也由此形成较少交易、较长持有的风格。

Reinvestment is an easily overlooked leg of the stool. Even excellent current margins cannot sustain compounding if incremental capital lacks attractive uses. His research connects existing business economics with future opportunities, supporting a patient style with relatively few transactions.
summary: 找到复利机器：卓越的生意、可信的管理层、持续的再投资机会。
Find compounding machines: an exceptional business, trustworthy managers and enduring reinvestment opportunities.

about: 格伦·格林伯格是 Brave Warrior Advisors 的管理董事和首席投资官，以集中研究和长期价值投资著称。
Glenn Greenberg is managing director and chief investment officer of Brave Warrior Advisors, known for concentrated research and long-term value investing.
他关注企业的竞争地位、现金创造能力与资本回报，把研究集中在少数能真正理解的生意上。与其频繁猜测市场，不如弄清企业为什么能赚钱、优势能保持多久，以及当前价格给了多少余地。

He focuses on competitive position, cash generation and returns on capital, concentrating research on a manageable set of understandable businesses. The central questions are why a business earns money, how long its advantages can last and what room the price leaves for error.
公司治理也是其公开观点的一部分。他曾向 SEC 提交关于股东参与治理的意见；这种关注与长期持有相连，因为管理层的资本配置最终会落到股东的回报上。

Governance also appears in his published views, including a submission to the SEC on shareholder participation. That concern connects to long-term ownership: management’s capital allocation ultimately affects shareholder outcomes.
格林伯格最初学习英语文学，后来进入哥伦比亚商学院，并在那里发现了研究企业的兴趣。这种经历与他偏好的直接表达颇为一致：把生意解释清楚，抓住决定长期现金流的少数变量，尽量减少对复杂预测的依赖。

Greenberg initially studied English literature before attending Columbia Business School, where he discovered an interest in investigating companies. His direct style seeks to explain a business clearly and identify the few variables driving long-term cash generation rather than rely on elaborate forecasts.
他的集中投资与大量案头研究相连。研究对象越少，就越需要对每家企业的客户、竞争格局、盈利能力和管理层形成具体认识；估值也因此围绕企业可以长期交给所有者的现金展开。公开访谈中，这种对简单、可理解生意的偏好十分鲜明。

Concentration goes together with intensive company research. A small portfolio demands detailed understanding of customers, competition, earning power and management. Valuation centers on cash a business can deliver to owners, reflecting his marked preference for understandable economics.
summary: 深入理解少数好生意，把竞争优势、现金流与管理层放在一起评估。
Understand a focused set of good businesses, assessing competitive advantage, cash flows and management together.

about: Baupost 于 1982 年成立。Seth Klarman 自公司成立以来负责投资，现任 CEO 和组合经理；其团队也包括总裁 Jim Mooney。
Baupost was established in 1982. Seth Klarman has overseen investments since inception and is CEO and portfolio manager, working alongside president Jim Mooney.
“安全边际”是克拉曼思想的核心，也是其著作 Margin of Safety 的主题：价格必须给判断错误和意外变化留下空间。先保护本金，机会不够好时愿意等待，而不是为了满仓而投资。

Margin of safety is central to Klarman’s thinking and to his book of the same name: price must leave room for analytical error and unforeseen change. Capital preservation comes first; insufficiently attractive opportunities warrant patience.
Baupost 的机会范围跨越股票、债券、私人信贷与房地产，常研究复杂、被忽视或有价值实现催化剂的投资。安全边际是一种估值和风险纪律，不是一套固定的股票名单。

Baupost invests across equities, debt, private credit and real estate, often studying complex, overlooked opportunities or investments with catalysts for value realization. Margin of safety is a valuation and risk discipline rather than a fixed stock list.
Baupost 最初为四个创始家族保护并积累跨代财富。这样的起点塑造了克拉曼对永久损失的重视：既研究潜在回报，也研究债务顺序、资产可变现程度、流动性与不利情形下的承受能力。股票只是他跨资产研究的一部分。

Baupost began by protecting and compounding wealth for four founding families across generations. That origin fits Klarman’s attention to permanent loss, capital structure, realizable assets, liquidity and resilience under adverse conditions. Equities are one part of a broader investment mandate.
他所说的逆向，依赖独立估值与耐心，而不只是选择与多数人相反的方向。复杂、冷门或被迫卖出的资产可能产生折价，但折价能否兑现，还要看合同条款、企业现金流和可能推动价值实现的事件。保留现金也是这套纪律的一部分。

His contrarian approach rests on independent appraisal and patience. Complexity, neglect or forced selling can create discounts, but realization depends on contractual rights, business cash flows and possible catalysts. Holding cash is part of that discipline.
summary: 先保全资本，再寻找回报；没有足够的安全边际，就耐心等待。
Preserve capital first; when the margin of safety is insufficient, wait patiently.

about: Bill Ackman 创建并领导 Pershing Square 投资机构。集团采用长期、集中投资方式，也可能运用对冲；旗下投资载体各有独立披露。
Bill Ackman founded and leads Pershing Square. The group uses long-term concentrated investing and may employ hedges; its vehicles have separate disclosures.
阿克曼在创立 Pershing Square 之前经营 Gotham Partners；Pershing Square 的首只基金于 2004 年开始运作。他的职业经历同时包含基本面研究与积极股东行动，因此公开作品常常一边分析企业，一边讨论治理结构与资本配置怎样改变企业的未来。

Before Pershing Square, Ackman ran Gotham Partners; the first Pershing Square fund began operating in 2004. His career combines fundamental research with shareholder activism, so his public work examines both business economics and how governance or capital allocation can change a company’s future.
阿克曼偏好简单、可预测、能持续产生自由现金流的企业，并把研究集中在少数高确信度的投资上。他也因股东行动而闻名：投资之后，通过治理、管理层和战略层面的参与推动价值实现。

Ackman favours understandable, predictable businesses with durable free cash flows, concentrating research on a few high-conviction investments. He is also known for shareholder activism, engaging with governance, management and strategy to help realize value.
他的投资方法并非始终不变。哥伦比亚访谈和长期股东交流，记录了他如何从复杂证券与具体交易，逐步把重点放到商业模式简单、竞争优势持久、现金流更可预测的企业。对于集中组合，他强调企业本身的质量应当成为风险保护的一部分。

His approach has evolved. Columbia interviews and shareholder communications trace a growing emphasis on understandable businesses, durable advantages and more predictable cash generation. In discussing concentrated portfolios, he treats business quality itself as an important source of protection.
“积极股东”在他的实践中也有不同层次：提出资本配置建议、推动管理层或董事会变化，以及支持优秀经营者把已有优势发挥出来。公开研究报告往往把行业结构、经营指标、估值和改变路径串成完整的投资论证，这也是他与只公开零散观点的投资者不同的地方。

His activism ranges from capital-allocation proposals and management or board changes to supporting capable operators. Public presentations often connect industry structure, operating measures, valuation and a path to change into an investment argument, making his research unusually visible.
他也会在长访谈中回顾失败、公开争论与个人判断的修正。研究这些作品，最有价值的是看他如何解释当年的前提、后来遇到的事实，以及这段经历如何改变其选股与参与企业的方式。

His long-form interviews revisit setbacks, public disputes and revised judgments. Their value lies in his account of the original assumptions, the subsequent evidence, and how the experience changed his approach to selecting and engaging with companies.
summary: 寻找简单、可预测、能产生自由现金流的企业，以集中投资和积极参与推动价值实现。
Seek simple, predictable, cash-generative businesses, combining concentrated ownership with active engagement.

机构所说的灵活性，有明确的实践含义：既可以在公开市场研究证券，也可以在企业发展的重要转折点与创始人合作。愿意长期合作与跨资本结构寻找机会，使他的风格不能只用某一类股票或某一种估值倍数概括。

about: Bruce Berkowitz 是 Fairholme 的创始人及投资负责人。官方基金文件注明，他自管理公司 1997 年成立起担任 CIO，并负责基金的日常组合管理。
Bruce Berkowitz founded Fairholme. Official fund documents state that he has been CIO since the manager’s inception in 1997 and is responsible for portfolio management.
伯科威茨的风格是先看现金与资产，再看市场情绪：企业真正能产生多少现金，资产在保守假设下值多少，买入价格是否已经留下足够保护。

Berkowitz starts with cash and assets: how much cash a business can actually generate, what its assets are worth under conservative assumptions and whether the purchase price already provides protection.
集中、逆向与耐心是这套方法的另一面。少数研究充分的机会可能获得较大仓位，但集中程度与投资对象会随时间改变；理解其方法，应结合具体报告期的基金说明和持仓。

Concentration, contrarian judgment and patience are the other side of this method. Deeply researched opportunities may receive large allocations, while holdings and concentration change over time; dated fund reports provide the context.
“数现金、忽略人群”把他的研究重点说得很清楚：逐项理解企业收到和付出的资金，考虑维持经营必须花的钱，再看不同证券在资本结构中的权利。账面利润、可出售资产和最终归股东的现金，在他的分析中各有不同作用。

Counting cash and ignoring the crowd captures his emphasis: follow cash receipts and obligations, allow for maintenance spending, and examine each security’s rights in the capital structure. Reported profit, saleable assets and cash ultimately available to shareholders play different analytical roles.
他的公开问答也经常解释，为什么市场不喜欢的资产仍值得研究，以及持有现金如何保留选择权。这种方法要求把看好的理由写得具体，并持续核对经营和资产价值是否支持原来的判断；逆向与集中由此建立在实质研究之上。

His public Q&A often addresses why unpopular assets deserve investigation and how cash preserves options. The approach calls for specific reasons and continued checks of operating results and asset values, grounding contrarian concentration in research.
summary: 跟着现金走，算清资产价值；价格足够便宜时，才为少数机会投入资本。
Follow the cash and assess asset value; commit capital when the price offers sufficient protection.

霍金斯的框架可以用“企业、管理者、价格”来理解：像买下整家企业的私人买家一样估值，找值得合作的管理层，再以显著折价买入。便宜本身不够，生意与人也必须经得起研究。

Hawkins’s framework brings together business, people and price: appraise the company as a private buyer would, seek capable partners in management and buy at a substantial discount. A low price alone is insufficient.
Longleaf 的长期投资也带有积极参与的色彩。团队关注管理层如何配置资本、释放企业价值，并愿意用多年时间等待经营改善和价值兑现。

Longleaf combines long-term investing with engagement. The team studies capital allocation and how business value can be realized, giving operating improvements and value realization years to develop.
Longleaf 的“私人买家价值”试图回答：如果买下整个企业，一个有经验的经营者愿意付多少钱？团队会把经营现金流、独立资产、负债与资本配置放到一起研究，再要求市场价格相对估值留出明显折让。

Longleaf’s private-market value asks what an informed operator would pay for the whole business. The team considers operating cash flows, separate assets, liabilities and capital allocation, then seeks a substantial discount in the market price.
霍金斯强调与被投资企业和基金持有人建立伙伴关系。Southeastern 的研究人员跨行业寻找机会，团队成员也把自己的资金投入 Longleaf 基金；企业、管理者与价格的三重筛选，连接了研究方法、激励安排和长期持有。

Hawkins emphasizes partnerships with companies and fund investors. Southeastern researchers look across industries, and employees invest their own capital in Longleaf funds. Business, people and price connect research, incentives and long-term ownership.

Business Owner Fund 的名字就是投资方法：像长期股东一样选择企业，重点看多年后生意能否继续发展、竞争优势能否变强，以及管理层是否理性、诚实并与股东站在一起。

The Business Owner Fund’s name expresses the approach: choose businesses as a long-term owner, asking whether they can thrive years from now, strengthen their competitive advantages and be led by rational, honest managers aligned with shareholders.
维纳尔通过投资者信、年会交流与访谈公开分享思考。对他而言，长期资本、企业与管理层需要彼此匹配，持有的耐心来自对生意的理解，而不是忽略变化。

Vinall shares his thinking through letters, annual gatherings and interviews. Long-term capital must fit the business and its managers; patience comes from understanding the business while remaining attentive to change.
官网把选股归纳为四个具体问题：十年后企业能否继续繁荣，长期竞争优势是否增强，管理层是否做出正确示范，以及价格是否有吸引力。四者共同成立，才构成愿意长期拥有一家企业的基础。

The firm frames selection through four questions: whether a business can flourish a decade ahead, whether its advantage is strengthening, whether management sets the right example, and whether the price is attractive. Together they establish the case for long-term ownership.
每年在瑞士恩格尔贝格举行的聚会，将投资人、企业经营者与同行放到同一场讨论中。投资者信与年会问答也因此互为补充：书面材料呈现当时的思考，现场交流让企业文化、管理者品质和长期判断得到进一步展开。

The annual gathering in Engelberg brings together investors, business operators and fellow managers. Investor letters and gathering discussions complement one another: letters record contemporary thinking, while conversations develop questions about culture, management and long-term judgment.

about: 霍华德·马克思与布鲁斯·卡什等合伙人于 1995 年共同创立橡树资本。作为联合董事长，他负责投资哲学、客户沟通和重大投资与公司方向的判断；橡树以信用投资起家，研究高收益债、困境债务和资本结构中的错价。

Howard Marks co-founded Oaktree in 1995 with Bruce Karsh and other partners. As co-chair, he helps shape investment philosophy, client communication and major investment and corporate decisions. The firm’s roots lie in high-yield credit, distressed debt and capital-structure mispricing.
他在花旗从股票研究转向可转债与高收益债，随后在 TCW 带领相关团队。这个经历使他的价值观带有鲜明的债权人视角：先问本金能否收回，再问收益是否补偿风险；企业不错，并不意味着任何价格、任何资本结构都值得买。

His move from equity research at Citicorp into convertibles and high-yield bonds, followed by leading related teams at TCW, shaped a creditor’s perspective: examine principal recovery before asking whether return compensates for risk. Business quality alone does not justify every price or capital structure.
马克思把市场比作钟摆。企业的经营会变化，投资者的情绪、信贷的松紧和愿意支付的价格，往往摆动得更远。识别身处周期的大致位置，是为了调整进攻与防守，而不是报出下个月的指数点位。

Marks’s pendulum describes how sentiment, credit availability and prices can swing farther than business conditions. Locating the broad stage of a cycle helps calibrate offense and defense; it does not supply a precise near-term market forecast.
第二层次思维，是把自己的判断放回市场价格里检验：不仅要理解一家公司，还要理解多数人相信什么、价格隐含什么，以及自己的分歧是否正确。投资机会来自判断与共识之间有依据的差异，不来自为了不同而不同。

Second-level thinking tests an assessment against the expectations already embedded in price. It asks what others believe and whether a contrary assessment is both different and right, rather than treating disagreement itself as an advantage.
自 1990 年代以来的备忘录构成一条可追溯的思考线索：从预测的局限、互联网泡沫和金融危机，到利率环境的结构性变化。文字中反复出现的是概率、风险溢价、市场心理，以及知道自己不知道什么的纪律。

His memos form a dated record spanning prediction, the internet bubble, financial crises and structural changes in interest rates. Probability, risk premiums, psychology and intellectual humility recur across this work.

about: 乔尔·格林布拉特是 Gotham Asset Management 的管理合伙人兼联席首席投资官，1985 年创立了其前身 Gotham Capital。他与罗伯特·戈德斯坦长期合作，也曾在哥伦比亚商学院讲授价值与特殊情形投资逾二十年。

Joel Greenblatt is managing principal and co-CIO of Gotham Asset Management, successor to Gotham Capital, which he founded in 1985. His longtime partner is Robert Goldstein, and he taught value and special-situation investing at Columbia for more than two decades.
他最鲜明的特点，是把复杂问题拆回简单的算术：这门生意值多少，现在要付多少钱？早期关注分拆、重组和清算等特殊情形，寻找因交易结构、投资限制或持有人被动卖出而出现的机会。《股市天才》把这种从文件与激励中寻找机会的方法讲给普通投资者。

His work reduces complexity to two questions: what is the business worth, and what must the investor pay? His special-situation writing examines spin-offs, restructurings and liquidations, including opportunities created by forced selling and structural constraints.
“神奇公式”把两条判断分开排序，再结合起来：企业使用经营资本的效率，以及投资者按企业价值买入时得到的盈利收益率。好公司和好价格缺一不可；排名是筛选入口，仍要检查盈利是否可持续、资本项目是否算对。

The magic formula combines separate rankings for return on operating capital and earnings yield on enterprise value. Business quality and purchase price both matter; the screen still calls for checking sustainable earnings and the capital denominator.
这套方法也依赖执行。官方说明强调分散持有，必要时分批建仓，约一年后按规则更新组合。它的优势不在预测下个月的热门股，而在于用能够解释的规则，反复寻找价格与经营价值的差距。

The official implementation emphasizes diversification, potentially staggered purchases, and rules-based renewal after about a year. Discipline connects the valuation idea with a repeatable portfolio process.
今天的 Gotham 同时经营多头与多空策略，旗下 ETF 还包括重新赋权的标普 500 组合、广泛分散的价值组合与净空头产品。阅读这里的机构持仓，重点是证券权重、增减股数和策略结构；不能把这份合并申报理解成他个人精选的“神奇公式股票清单”。

Her patience targets a specific mismatch: short evaluation periods, emotion and events can obscure a company’s longer-term earnings power. Time arbitrage studies that gap and aligns the capital horizon with the investment thesis.
Patient 的估值研究同时考察基本面、竞争战略、同行、管理层和资本配置。价值并不只存在于低市盈率公司；关键是市场的隐含预期是否低于企业能够实现的未来，而不是仅凭一个静态倍数分类。

The firm’s valuation work considers fundamentals, strategy, peers, management and capital allocation. Value is not confined to low-multiple businesses; the question is whether embedded expectations fall short of what the business can deliver.

Her commentaries can be read through expectations, operating results and price response: what the market feared, what occurred and whether the gap narrowed. Contrarian positioning is a starting point; ownership still depends on continuing fundamental and valuation work.

Time, not timing
text: 研究长期价值与短期价格的错位，把持有期限作为研究的一部分。
Study the mismatch between long-term value and short-term prices and make the investment horizon part of the research.

title: 从预期差开始
Start with expectations
text: 找到市场过度悲观或关注不足的环节，比较价格隐含的结果与自己研究得到的结果。
Identify excessive pessimism or neglect and compare embedded expectations with researched outcomes.

title: 给企业完整估值
Value the whole business
text: 联合考察基本面、战略、同业、管理层与资本配置，不把价值投资压缩成低倍数筛选。
Combine fundamentals, strategy, peers, management and capital allocation rather than reduce value to a low-multiple screen.

title: 让资本愿意等待
Align capital with patience
text: 耐心需要客户、激励和流程的配合，同时持续检查投资逻辑是否仍然成立。
Patience requires aligned clients, incentives and process alongside continuing checks on the thesis.

title: 持续检查经营与预期
Revisit operations and expectations
text: 持有之后仍要比较企业实际进展与市场隐含预期，耐心需要能够被事实支持。
After investing, keep comparing operating progress with embedded expectations; facts must continue to support patience.

title: 随赔率调整进攻与防守
Adjust offense and defense as odds change
text: 价格接近价值时降低部分风险，把注意力转向剩余回报空间更好、能适应不同环境的机会。
As price approaches value, moderate some risks and examine opportunities with better remaining upside and resilience across scenarios.

title: 让时间成为同伴
Make time an ally
text: 短期噪声会放大价格与价值的距离。把研究做深，把期限放长，再用事实检验耐心。
Short-term noise can widen the gap between price and value. Research deeply, extend the horizon and test patience against the facts.
